# Analysis ledger categories

Every executed step is recorded in `workbench/analysis_ledger.jsonl` under one category. Steps in the categories `descriptive`, `inferential` only read data: an Agent workflow made only of them runs without a confirmation click, up to 12 steps at a time and 30 inferential tests per Agent session. Everything else waits for the user's confirmation. Categories that change data: `data_change`, `deletion`, `metadata_change`.

## Numeric check

Before an Agent reply is shown, every decimal number in it, and every whole number from 1,000 up (years excepted), must match a number the Agent was given, rounded correctly to the digits written, or a value from the `calculate` tool. A failing reply is sent back 1 time(s) with the closest real values; if the rewrite still fails, it is shown with a warning naming the numbers.
